text.en:
Currency Act
(CHAPTER 69)
Currency
(Denomination and Characteristics
of Currency Note)
Notification 2017
Pursuant to section 17(5) of the Currency Act, it is notified for general information that the denomination and characteristics of the currency note issued on 5 July 2017 by the Monetary Authority of Singapore are as shown in the Schedule.

THE SCHEDULE
Description of the 50th Anniversary of the Currency
Interchangeability Agreement Commemorative Note
issued on 5 July 2017
Denomination
$50
Size
1.Length: 158 mm
2.Width: 75 mm
Predominant and Secondary Colours (Front)
1.Predominant Colour: Gold
2.Secondary Colours: Brown, Yellow, Black and Red
Predominant and Secondary Colours (Back)
1.Predominant Colour: Gold
2.Secondary Colours: Brown, Yellow, Green and Purple
Design (Front)
1.The front design features the portrait of Singapore’s first President, the late Mr Yusof bin Ishak.
2.The 50th anniversary logo of the Currency Interchangeability Agreement is located at the top left of the note. It depicts the Simpur, a prominent flower found in Brunei Darussalam, and the Vanda Miss Joaquim, Singapore’s national flower. Below the logo are the words “CURRENCY INTERCHANGEABILITY AGREEMENT”.
3.The words “BRUNEI DARUSSALAM•SINGAPORE” are above the see‑through, colour‑shifting window security feature located at the bottom left of the note. This security feature depicts Brunei Darussalam’s Istana Nurul Iman on the left and Singapore’s Istana on the right.
4.The Singapore Coat of Arms appears on the top centre‑left portion, above the words “THIS NOTE IS LEGAL TENDER”.
5.The signature and seal of Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam, Chairman, Monetary Authority of Singapore, are below the words “FIFTY DOLLARS” while the word “SINGAPORE” is at the bottom centre‑left of the note.
6.One set of the asymmetrical serial number appears horizontal at the bottom of the centre‑left portion while the other set appears vertical on the right‑hand side.
7.The denomination numeral “50” is located at the top right‑hand corner with the Braille pattern on the right.
Design (Back)
1.The back design showcases the collaboration between Brunei Darussalam and Singapore, represented by the areas of defence, education and tourism.
2.Cooperation in the area of defence is depicted on the left foreground, featuring military personnel from the Royal Brunei Armed Forces and the Singapore Armed Forces in their ceremonial uniform.
3.Collaboration in the area of education is depicted on the right foreground, featuring students from both countries engaging in cross‑cultural learning and exchanging of ideas.
4.The background features a scene from Brunei Darussalam’s Ulu Temburong National Park and the Singapore Botanic Gardens, affirming the importance of the Currency Interchangeability Agreement in facilitating tourism between Brunei Darussalam and Singapore.
5.The denomination numeral “50” is located at the top centre‑right while the word “SINGAPORE” is at the bottom centre‑right of the note.
6.The words “1967-2017 50 YEARS OF CURRENCY INTERCHANGEABILITY AGREEMENT” appear on the right‑centre portion of the note.
7.The words “SINGAPORE•BRUNEI DARUSSALAM” are above the see‑through colour‑shifting window security feature located at the bottom right of the note.
(a)Front Design of the $50 Commemorative Note.
(b)Back Design of the $50 Commemorative Note.
Actual size: 158 mm × 75 mm
